raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

`MooncakeConnector` now sends the decode KV layout to each prefill worker once, instead of on every pull. Later pulls carry only block ids and a `layout_id`, and decode stops attaching the layout only after prefill echoes that id back. This is the exchange-once, cache-per-peer model `NixlConnector` already uses for its handshake. Follows the packed-region work in #57952.

## Claims

- On DeepSeek-V4-Flash 4P4D (146 registered regions), each later pull is **9184 B smaller per rank**: 9500 B → 316 B at ~8k tokens. The saving is the same at 508 and 8008 tokens.
- Prefill-side control-plane time per pull drops from **0.078 ms to 0.014 ms** (steady-state P50). The absolute saving is ~0.06 ms, so **TTFT does not change** (1.10 s at ~8k tokens on both sides).
- Mixed versions stay correct in both directions. A prefill without this change never receives a layout-less pull; a decode without this change keeps today's behavior.
- No accuracy change on gsm8k (Qwen3-0.6B 1P1D; DeepSeek-V4-Flash 4P4D vs. single node).

## Validation

**Unit tests**: 123 passed.

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -v \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_mooncake_connector_hybrid_mamba.py
```

The environment was `uv venv --system-site-packages`, with the default test model `facebook/opt-125m`. The cu129 precompiled wheel for the base commit returned 404, so this is not a `VLLM_USE_PRECOMPILED=1` install.

New tests cover:
- layout-less pulls after the echo;
- a `LAYOUT_MISS` resend;
- a prefill that never echoes (old peer);
- a reused layout arriving under a new id;
- LRU eviction.

`pre-commit` passes: `ruff-check`, `ruff-format`, `typos`, and `mypy-3.12 --hook-stage manual`.

**Version matrix** (Qwen2.5-0.5B, greedy, TP=1, RDMA). "Old" is `origin/main` (`4e4d75c459`). The `MooncakeXferMetadata to <addr> is N bytes (layout|blocks)` line is a DEBUG log (`VLLM_LOGGING_LEVEL=DEBUG`). These runs used an earlier revision that logged the same line once per address at INFO.

| Prefill | Decode | PP (P/D) | Decode log | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| new | new | 1/1 | `1615 B (layout)`, then `256 B (blocks)` | same output, 100% external prefix hits |
| old | new | 1/1 | `(layout)` only, never `(blocks)` | same output |
| old | new | 2/1 | `(layout)` only for both prefill addresses; no `no matching consumer` on prefill | same output |
| new | old | 1/1 | (old decode has no size log) | same output |

The old/new-PP 1/1 and new/old rows were run on the pre-rebase commit; the Mooncake code is identical. The LRU commit does not touch the code those two rows run: an old prefill never executes it, and an old decode sends `layout_id=0`, which the new prefill never stores.

**Bytes and TTFT** (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, TP=4, EP, fp8, block 256, 4P4D on one node). Each TTFT row is 8 streamed requests with `max_tokens=1`, after warmup.

| | `origin/main` | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Metadata per pull, per rank, ~8k tokens | 9483 B every pull | 9500 B first pull, then 316 B |
| Prefill control plane, steady-state P50 / P99 | 0.078 / 0.099 ms (n=44) | 0.014 / 0.029 ms (n=24) |
| TTFT, ~8k tokens | 1.092–1.097 s | 1.096–1.099 s |

The control-plane time was measured from `send_kv_to_decode` entry to the end of region-length validation, on all 4 ranks, dropping the first pull. The timing code was temporary and is not part of this PR.

**Accuracy** (gsm8k, `exact_match,strict-match`, 1319 questions).

| Setup | Score |
|---|---|
| Qwen3-0.6B 1P1D, `tests/v1/kv_connector/mooncake_integration/run_accuracy_test.sh` | 0.422 (expected 0.41 ± 0.05) |
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash 4P4D | 0.951 (1255/1319) |
| DeepSeek-V4-Flash single node, TP=4, same eager / fp8 / `max_num_seqs=8` | 0.951 (1254/1319) |

Both P/D runs had 100% external prefix hits and 0 failed transfers.

**Not covered end to end.** Prefill side-channel ports come from `bind_to_random_port`, and decode RPC ports from the transfer engine, so a restarted peer always comes back at a new address. Three paths therefore have unit coverage only:
- the `LAYOUT_MISS` resend;
- the same address reusing a layout under a new id;
- LRU eviction followed by a resend.

Prefill and decode restarts were run end to end; they re-sent the layout to the new address, with unchanged output.

## Details

**Why.** Every pull sends the whole registered layout in `MooncakeXferMetadata`: base addresses, block lengths, layer names, group ids and row offsets. On a 146-region model that is ~9 KB per rank per pull, mostly layer names. Prefill then builds and hashes a tuple of all of it on every batch, just to hit `_prepared_transfer_regions`. Both costs grow with the number of registered regions, not with the request.

**Prior art: `NixlConnector`.** NIXL already exchanges the KV layout once per remote engine and keeps the per-request message small:

| | `NixlConnector` (pull mode) | `MooncakeConnector`, this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Data direction | Decode reads from prefill, so **decode** caches the prefill layout | Prefill writes into decode, so **prefill** caches the decode layout |
| When the layout is exchanged | Once per remote engine, in `_ensure_handshake`; concurrent requests to the same engine share one handshake future | Once per decode worker address, piggybacked on the first pull |
| Where it is cached | `add_remote_agent` stores `kv_caches_base_addr[engine_id][tp_rank]`, block lengths, and region metadata | `_layout_by_peer`, keyed by decode host, port, ranks, and `layout_id` |
| Per-request message | `RemoteMeta`: block ids, host, port, `engine_id`, request id | `req_blocks` and `layout_id` |
| How a new layout is detected | The cache is keyed by `engine_id`; a restarted engine has a new id and is handshaken anew, and the replaced engine is cleaned up (`_track_remote_engine_replacement`) | Each `register_kv_caches` mints a new `layout_id`; an unknown id gets `LAYOUT_MISS` and a resend |

Mooncake has no separate handshake round trip; decode simply sends its pull to the prefill side channel. So instead of adding a handshake, this PR makes the first pull carry the layout. Prefill's echo of `layout_id` then plays the part of NIXL's handshake response: decode treats the layout as delivered only after it sees the echo, so a peer that never echoes keeps getting the full layout. NIXL's compatibility hash (`NixlHandshakePayload.compatibility_hash`) is out of scope here.

**Protocol.**
- `register_kv_caches` draws a random nonzero 63-bit `layout_id`. A counter would restart at 1 in every process, so a restarted decode at the same address could match a stale prefill entry and be written with the old layout.
- Prefill stores aligned regions by `(decode host, port, tp_rank, pp_size, tp_size, layout_id)`. It stores them on both a fresh alignment and a `_prepared_transfer_regions` hit. A hit can carry a new id for a layout prefill has already seen.
- Prefill echoes `layout_id` in `MooncakeXferResponse` once it holds that layout. Decode omits the layout for a worker address only after seeing the echo.
  - A plain `FINISH` is not enough. A prefill without this change ignores the new field and answers `FINISH`. With equal PP it would then reject every layout-less pull. With different PP, `allow_partial_layers` would align zero regions, transfer nothing, and report success.
- A layout-less pull whose id prefill does not hold gets the new `LAYOUT_MISS` status. Decode resends with the layout once; a second miss fails the request normally. Only layout-less pulls can receive `LAYOUT_MISS`, and only a new decode sends those, so an old decode never sees the new enum value.
- `_layout_by_peer` is an LRU capped at 1024 entries, because every decode re-registration mints a new id. Eviction is always safe: the evicted decode gets `LAYOUT_MISS` and resends.

**Tradeoff.** About 130 net lines in the connector, for ~9 KB and ~0.06 ms per pull, with no TTFT change on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. The case for the change is that this overhead is fixed per pull and grows with the region count and layer-name length, so it grows with deeper and multi-cache models. It is not a latency win at today's scale.

**Limitations (pre-existing, unchanged here).**
- `_prepared_transfer_regions` is still unbounded. Its key includes decode base addresses, so it grows on every decode restart. Its entries could take the same LRU in a follow-up.
- After a prefill restart, the proxy must be restarted too. Otherwise decode keeps the old `engine_id` and requests stall instead of failing.
- A pull with empty `req_blocks` gets no response.

**Related PRs.**
- #59592 adds `remote_block_size` to `MooncakeXferMetadata`, in code this PR moves into `_build_pull_metadata`. Whichever lands second should set it on both full and layout-less pulls.
- #59625 (draft, sleep mode over RDMA) re-registers KV caches on wake-up. Here that mints a new `layout_id` and clears the caches, so a woken peer re-sends or re-receives the layout. That PR also restructures `send_kv_to_decode`, so expect a textual conflict.

**Duplicate check.** No open PR sends the Mooncake layout once or caches it per peer. Searched `mooncake layout`, `mooncake handshake` and `mooncake metadata` with `gh pr list --repo vllm-project/vllm --state open --search ...`.

**AI assistance.** This PR was written with AI assistance (Cursor). I reviewed every changed line and ran the validation above.

@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@
 from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch
 
 import httpx
+import msgspec
 import pytest
 import torch
 import zmq.asyncio
@@ -2226,6 +2227,215 @@ def counting(*args, **kwargs):
     assert calls == 6
 
 
+def _short_xfer_meta(worker, layout_id: int, req_blocks: dict) -> MooncakeXferMetadata:
+    return MooncakeXferMetadata(
+        remote_hostname="peer",
+        remote_port=9,
+        remote_tp_size=worker.tp_size,
+        remote_tp_rank=0,
+        remote_pp_size=worker.pp_size,
+        layout_id=layout_id,
+        req_blocks=req_blocks,
+        kv_caches_base_addr=[],
+        block_lens=[],
+        kv_block_lens=[],
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_steady_pull_omits_layout_and_unknown_id_asks_for_resend():
+    """A later pull is much smaller, and an unseen layout_id is not guessed."""
+    n = 146
+    names = [f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn" for i in range(n)]
+    req_blocks = {"d": ("xfer", [[1, 2, 3]])}
+    full = MooncakeXferMetadata(
+        remote_hostname="h",
+        remote_port=1,
+        remote_tp_size=4,
+        remote_tp_rank=0,
+        layout_id=1,
+        req_blocks=req_blocks,
+        kv_caches_base_addr=list(range(n)),
+        block_lens=[4096] * n,
+        kv_block_lens=[3000] * n,
+        registered_layer_names=names,
+        registered_layer_indices=list(range(n)),
+        registered_group_indices=[i % 5 for i in range(n)],
+        registered_shared_group_ids=[[] for _ in range(n)],
+        registered_row_offsets=[i * 100 for i in range(n)],
+    )
+    steady = MooncakeXferMetadata(
+        remote_hostname="h",
+        remote_port=1,
+        remote_tp_size=4,
+        remote_tp_rank=0,
+        layout_id=1,
+        req_blocks=req_blocks,
+        kv_caches_base_addr=[],
+        block_lens=[],
+        kv_block_lens=[],
+    )
+    encoder = msgspec.msgpack.Encoder()
+    full_bytes = len(encoder.encode(full))
+    steady_bytes = len(encoder.encode(steady))
+    assert steady_bytes < full_bytes * 0.2
+
+    worker, _, regions, _ = _register_sliced_packed_mla([0, 1])
+    calls = 0
+    original = worker._get_transfer_regions
+
+    def counting(*args, **kwargs):
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        return original(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    worker._get_transfer_regions = counting
+
+    def handshake(layout_id: int) -> MooncakeXferMetadata:
+        return _xfer_meta(
+            regions,
+            req_blocks,
+            remote_hostname="peer",
+            remote_port=9,
+            remote_tp_size=worker.tp_size,
+            remote_pp_size=worker.pp_size,
+            layout_id=layout_id,
+        )
+
+    prepared = worker._prepare_transfer_regions(handshake(1))
+    assert prepared[2] is None
+    assert calls == 2
+    stored = worker._layout_by_peer[worker._peer_layout_key(handshake(1))]
+    assert stored == (prepared[0], prepared[1])
+
+    # Same layout under a new id hits the tuple cache and must still be stored.
+    worker._prepare_transfer_regions(handshake(3))
+    assert calls == 2
+    assert worker._peer_layout_key(handshake(3)) in worker._layout_by_peer
+
+    sock = MagicMock()
+    sock.send_multipart = AsyncMock()
+    await worker.send_kv_to_decode(b"d", sock, _short_xfer_meta(worker, 5, req_blocks))
+    _, payload = sock.send_multipart.call_args[0][0]
+    response = worker._xfer_resp_decoder.decode(payload)
+    assert response.status == MooncakeXferResponseStatus.LAYOUT_MISS
+    assert calls == 2
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_peer_layouts_evict_least_recently_used(monkeypatch):
+    """Stale layout ids are bounded, and an evicted peer is asked to resend."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mooncake_connector, "_MAX_PEER_LAYOUTS", 2)
+    worker, _, regions, _ = _register_sliced_packed_mla([0])
+    req_blocks = {"d": ("xfer", [[1]])}
+
+    def handshake(layout_id: int) -> MooncakeXferMetadata:
+        return _xfer_meta(
+            regions,
+            req_blocks,
+            remote_hostname="peer",
+            remote_port=9,
+            remote_tp_size=worker.tp_size,
+            remote_pp_size=worker.pp_size,
+            layout_id=layout_id,
+        )
+
+    worker._prepare_transfer_regions(handshake(1))
+    worker._prepare_transfer_regions(handshake(3))
+    assert worker._lookup_peer_layout(_short_xfer_meta(worker, 1, req_blocks))
+    worker._prepare_transfer_regions(handshake(5))
+
+    assert worker._lookup_peer_layout(_short_xfer_meta(worker, 1, req_blocks))
+    assert worker._lookup_peer_layout(_short_xfer_meta(worker, 5, req_blocks))
+    sock = MagicMock()
+    sock.send_multipart = AsyncMock()
+    await worker.send_kv_to_decode(b"d", sock, _short_xfer_meta(worker, 3, req_blocks))
+    _, payload = sock.send_multipart.call_args[0][0]
+    response = worker._xfer_resp_decoder.decode(payload)
+    assert response.status == MooncakeXferResponseStatus.LAYOUT_MISS
+
+
+class _ScriptedSock:
+    def __init__(self, responses: list[bytes], sent: list[bytes]):
+        self._responses = responses
+        self._sent = sent
+
+    def setsockopt(self, *_args, **_kwargs):
+        return None
+
+    async def send(self, data: bytes):
+        self._sent.append(data)
+
+    async def recv(self):
+        return self._responses.pop(0)
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *_args):
+        return False

+def _single_pull() -> dict[str, PullReqMeta]:
+    return {
+        "d": PullReqMeta(
+            d_req_id="d",
+            transfer_id="t",
+            local_block_ids=[[1]],
+            remote_engine_id="p",
+            remote_bootstrap_addr="http://bootstrap",
+        )
+    }
+
+
+async def _pull_once(worker, addr: str, responses: list[MooncakeXferResponse]):
+    sent: list[bytes] = []
+    encoded = [worker._encoder.encode(response) for response in responses]
+    with patch(
+        "vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.mooncake."
+        "mooncake_connector.make_zmq_socket",
+        return_value=_ScriptedSock(encoded, sent),
+    ):
+        await worker.receive_kv_from_single_worker(addr, _single_pull())
+    return sent

+async def test_pull_resends_layout_when_prefill_forgot_it():
+    worker, _, _, _ = _register_sliced_packed_mla([0])
+    addr = "tcp://peer:1"
+    worker._acked_layout_peers.add(addr)
+    sent = await _pull_once(
+        worker,
+        addr,

+            MooncakeXferResponse(status=MooncakeXferResponseStatus.LAYOUT_MISS),
+            MooncakeXferResponse(
+                status=MooncakeXferResponseStatus.FINISH,
+                ok_reqs=["d"],
+                layout_id=worker._kv_layout_id,
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+    assert len(sent) == 2
+    assert len(sent[1]) > len(sent[0])
+    assert addr in worker._acked_layout_peers
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pull_keeps_layout_for_prefill_that_does_not_echo_it():
+    """A prefill without layout_id support never gets a layout-less pull."""
+    worker, _, _, _ = _register_sliced_packed_mla([0])

+    finish = MooncakeXferResponse(

+    )

+    assert addr not in worker._acked_layout_peers
+    second = await _pull_once(worker, addr, [finish])
+    assert len(second[0]) == len(first[0])
